rules.surfaceStub: A card rendered on a surface not in its platforms shows the onComputer stub. A card's own stub (offByChoice, needsFlux, needsKey, notYet, gate states) is its off state on a surface where it exists.
rules.controlPlatforms: A control whose platforms are narrower than its card's renders as a dimmed row with the onComputer line and Copy the path; readouts beside it stay live. readOnlyOn lists surfaces where the whole card is read-only.
rules.botAnchors: Every bot row renders data-setting="bot.{section}.{row}" and DOM anchor bot-setting-{row} (settings-index.ts:74). Rows with indexed:false are readouts with nothing to set. A control with a sub shares its parent's row and anchor.
rules.effortOptions: Engine decides means no effort is set (SettingsPanel.tsx:764 passes undefined). The levels that follow are the ones the engine supports out of EFFORT_LEVELS none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max (contracts.ts:43), with their shipped labels.
rules.fixtureStates: A bot's routeState derives from its engine, account and credit fixtures below; one state per account, one credit reading per Flux account. Low credit and Checking are scenario overrides.
